title: Trail Chunk
description: A shard of a trip's GPS trail. Solves the 1 MiB document cliff.
x-direct-write-exception: This is the ONE deliberate exception to the rule that a server-mediated write is safer. Chunking exists to reduce the number of writes. A Function per write adds a network hop, and the parent trip doc plus the size limit protect it fully. The rule enforces the parent vanId, the size cap, and denies update and delete.

points.description: The points in this chunk. Capped at 1000 so the document stays under the 1 MiB limit.

from.description: The index of the first point in the trip's full trail.

to.description: The index of the last point in the trip's full trail, exclusive.
